evals.name: royalty-double-count-challenge
evals.prompt: Challenge a biotech underwriting that values a drug's royalties, adds all commercial milestones at face value, includes acquired royalty cash flow before a creditor sweep ends, and concludes INVESTABLE. The source pack and model assumptions are available. Form an independent view before reconciling the verdict.
evals.expected_output: Reconstructs price-implied value independently; audits ownership and temporary creditor claims; identifies double-counting between high-sales royalties and milestones; tests cash-flow timing; calculates a conclusion-changing breakpoint; distinguishes factual, probability, valuation and timing disagreements; concludes Survives With Revisions, Not Decision-Ready or Fails as supported; does not silently rewrite the original or size a position.

evals.name: cyclical-duration-challenge
evals.prompt: Challenge a tanker underwriting that extrapolates one extreme route assessment across the fleet and assumes rates remain elevated through 2028. The stock already doubled. Audit the thesis independently.
evals.expected_output: Separates marginal route quotes from fleet-realized TCEs; reconstructs open days and normalized-rate path; tests duration, traffic recovery, insurance, volume destruction and fleet supply; calculates the rate/duration breakpoint embedded in the price; audits annualized return and opportunity cost; reaches one allowed challenge verdict with required revisions.

evals.name: surviving-case-allocation-handoff
evals.prompt: Independently challenge an Amazon underwriting that appears decision-ready and INVESTABLE. The case survives your valuation review, but the portfolio already has substantial AI-capex exposure and the user has not provided a position loss budget. Reconcile the case and state the next gate.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the challenge focused on underwriting facts, valuation, timing and opportunity cost; identifies AI-capex cluster exposure as an allocation constraint without inventing the portfolio or risk tolerance; preserves or revises the underwriting posture as supported; hands reconciled Bear loss, return, horizon, liquidity and cluster concerns to Portfolio Capital Allocation; does not choose an exact weight or imply that a surviving underwriting must be funded.
